audit_items.actual_evidence: x86 interpolation produced C:\Program Files(x86), unlike C:\Program Files (x86). Lexical descending gs9.56.1/gs10.06.0 chooses gs9.56.1. Only first GS folder is examined.

audit_items.title: GS failure final summary and exit
audit_items.actual_evidence: Nonzero GS conversion can reach existence-only email summary and final exit 0. Terminating launch/log faults may prevent reaching that exit.

audit_items.title: Unbounded native command and destination preflight
audit_items.actual_evidence: No command-length guard/timeout; first destination write is log, with no writability preflight.

audit_items.title: Public parameter interface

audit_items.actual_evidence: No size comparison; archive-safe/smaller/Windows 10/PS7 claims have no project acceptance evidence. Inventory does not disprove those platforms.
